text.p: The Williams Cos Inc said on Monday that it would reorganize its communications and technologies units and rename the unit Williams Communications Group.

The company said its new group will involve Williams Telecommunications Systems Inc and the WilTech Group, which handles multimedia transmission technologies and is comprised of Vyvx Inc, Williams Learning Network, ITC mediaConferencing and the Business Channel LLC.

WilTech President and Chief Operating Officer Henry Hirsch will become vice chairman and chief executive of Williams Communications Group, and Howard Janzen, who is currently WilTech Group president and Vyvx Inc chairman, will head the business units of the combined organization, the company said.
The new structure is effective January 1, the company said.
